questions.q: Which actor plays Krishna, the masked hero of Krrish?
questions.why: Hrithik Roshan has a dual role, as the masked hero and as the scientist in the story.

questions.q: Besides Krishna, which character does the star play in Krrish?
questions.why: Hrithik has a dual role as Krishna and Dr. Rohit Mehra.

questions.q: The Krrish look began as a disguise for rescuing children trapped at which place?
questions.why: Krishna's black clown-style mask and inside-out jacket came from a rescue during a fire at the Great Bombay Circus.

questions.q: Krishna follows Priya to which foreign city, where most of Krrish was shot?
questions.why: More than 60 percent of the film was shot in Singapore.

questions.q: Which actress plays Priya, Krishna's love interest?
questions.why: Priyanka Chopra plays Priya Kalyanan in the 2006 film.

questions.q: Which veteran actress plays Krishna's grandmother Sonia?
questions.why: Rekha plays Sonia Mehra, who raises Krishna away from the world's eyes.

questions.q: Which Hong Kong action director choreographed Krrish's stunts?
questions.why: Tony Ching (Ching Siu-Tung) designed the film's wire-fu action.

questions.q: During a flying stunt, a wire broke and the lead actor fell roughly how far?
questions.why: Hrithik reportedly fell around fifty feet when a wire snapped during a flying stunt.

questions.q: Krrish won the National Film Award for which category?
questions.why: The film won the 54th National Film Award for Best Special Effects.

questions.q: Krrish (2006) is the sequel to which 2003 film?
questions.why: It follows Koi... Mil Gaya (2003); the third film, Krrish 3, came in 2013.
